descriptor.name: Clark County Assessor parcel polygons
descriptor.scope: 90 valid, distinct Clark County assessor parcel polygons verified in thirteen local cells around the Las Vegas WUP settlement locator, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m². Forced paging, fresh exact geometry hashes, explicit absence, footprint and complete binding passed across recorded retries. Intermittent HTTP 500 responses remain documented. County coverage near this point does not establish municipal-only, citywide or countywide completeness.
